Interface TribeDeck

All Known Implementing Classes:
Artist, Builder, EventCard, Gatherer, Hunter, Inventor, Shaman
public interface TribeDeck
Represents a unified contract for any game card template capable of residing within the main tribe deck or appearing in the market rows (both upper and lower) on the central board.

This interface provides a polymorphic abstraction over structurally distinct card categories, allowing the game setup systems, deck managers, and market layout handlers to manipulate them interchangeably during card drawing, shifting, and purchasing routines.

    • isEvent

      default boolean isEvent()
      Helper discriminator method used to distinguish background events from interactable character assets without relying on unsafe reflection or instanceof checks.

      The default implementation returns false. Concrete event components must override this method to return true.

      Returns:
      true if the implementing card is an event scenario; false if it represents a recruitable character card
